answer_2.quote: Additionally, we incorporate objective automatic metrics to assess sample quality, including Multi-resolution STFT (M-STFT) loss, Perceptual Evaluation of Speech Quality (PESQ), Mel-cepstral distortion (MCD) with dynamic time warping, Periodicity error, and the F1 score for voiced/unvoiced (V/UV) classification.
automatic_metrics: Mel-cepstral distortion (MCD) with dynamic time warping

answer_4.quote: This subjective evaluation is carried out by ten volunteers, and the reported SMOS scores include a 95% confidence interval.
